_comment: The emtk results table of the Burst IRF & Background tool: one row per detector (see IrfBackgroundViewModel.results_rows). A data_table section, drawn by emtk.view_form.

sections.title: IRF and background per detector
sections.description: The extraction result: the background rate, the prompt position and the photon counts it rests on, per detector.

columns.title: Detector
columns.description: The detector the row belongs to.

columns.title: Background (kHz)
columns.description: Background rate from the non-burst photons, averaged over the files.

columns.title: Prompt (ns)
columns.description: Micro-time of the IRF's rising edge, from the pooled non-burst photons.

columns.title: Non-burst
columns.description: Non-burst photons the IRF and the background were taken from.

columns.title: Burst
columns.description: Photons in bursts, excluded from the estimate.
